# SGTB register map, version 0.2 (2026-11-22)

Addresses are zero-based Modbus PDU addresses. Multi-register values are big-endian in word order.
A measured quantity is an IEEE 754 float32 in engineering units.

## Node registers (ICD-2), identical on every node

| Table | Address | Name | Type | Scale and unit | Rate | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| IR | 0 | HLTH.STATUS | u16 |  | 1 Hz | Node status bitfield |
| IR | 1 | HLTH.SEQ | u16 |  | 1 Hz | Heartbeat, increments each second |
| IR | 2 to 3 | HLTH.TIME | u32 | ms | 10 Hz | Node time stamp of the published set |
| IR | 4 + 16p + 0 to 1 | point p VRMS | f32 | V | 10 Hz | RMS voltage (or VDC) |
| IR | 4 + 16p + 2 to 3 | point p IRMS | f32 | A | 10 Hz | RMS current (or IDC) |
| IR | 4 + 16p + 4 to 5 | point p FREQ | f32 | Hz | 10 Hz | Frequency |
| IR | 4 + 16p + 6 to 7 | point p ANG | f32 | deg | 10 Hz | Voltage-current phase angle |
| IR | 4 + 16p + 8 to 9 | point p PF | f32 |  | 10 Hz | Power factor |
| IR | 4 + 16p + 10 to 11 | point p P | f32 | W | 10 Hz | Active power |
| IR | 4 + 16p + 12 to 13 | point p Q | f32 | var | 10 Hz | Reactive power |
| IR | 4 + 16p + 14 to 15 | point p S | f32 | VA | 10 Hz | Apparent power |
| IR | 80 | HLTH.FWVER | u16 |  | 1 Hz read | Firmware version, major in the high byte and minor in the low byte |
| IR | 81 | reserved | u16 | | 1 Hz read | Reads 0 |
| IR | 82 + 2p, two registers | point p E | u32 | 0.001 Wh | 1 Hz | Cumulative energy |
| HR | 100 to 101 | TIME_SET | u32 | ms | on command | Node time set, written by the host at 1 Hz |
| HR | 102 | ENERGY_RESET | u16 |  | on command | Energy reset, bit i resets point i; self-clearing |
| HR | 150 | CTRL | u16 |  | on command | Control word |
| HR | 110 to 141 | CAL gain, offset per channel | f32 x2 | | on command | Channel c at 110 + 4c; c = 2p + (0 voltage, 1 current) |
